content2.content: Poorly implemented notifications are the #1 reason users uninstall apps.

content4.content: Always allow users to customize which notifications they receive (e.g., granular settings for 'News', 'Promotions', 'Security').

content6.content: Send notifications that are personally relevant and at appropriate times (respect time zones).

content8.content: Treat the user's attention with respect. Value > Volume.
